narrative: C.J. Stroud is about as aligned a dynasty asset as you'll find — elite opportunity (A-), strong and rebounding production (B-), a perfect health signal, and a market that's rapidly repricing him upward, all pointing in the same direction. The only real tension in the grades is that the production score (82) lags the opportunity score (91) slightly, a gap explained primarily by missing three games in 2025 and the lingering shadow of a subpar 2024 — neither of which undermines the overall bull case. In a 12-team superflex league where starting two QBs is mandatory, Stroud's superflex premium amplifies his dynasty value considerably: a locked-in QB1 at age 25 with this efficiency profile and a +946 30-day market surge is a clear long-term hold. Unless an offer borders on a dynasty-reshaping haul, there is no compelling reason to sell — and if anything, the window to buy him at a reasonable price may already be closing.
